definitions.explanation: an informal or rough pronoun referring to a third person who is distant from both speaker and listener

examples.japanese: あいつは{信用|しんよう}できない。
あいつが{言|い}ったことは{本当|ほんとう}だ。
examples.english: What that person said is true.

examples.japanese: あいつとはもう{二度|にど}と{会|あ}いたくない。
examples.english: I never want to see that person again.

notes:
REGISTER:
Informal/rough. Can sound contemptuous or rude depending on context. Often used among male friends casually.

KO-SO-A-DO SYSTEM:
Part of the demonstrative pronoun system for people:
- こいつ (this guy - near speaker)
- そいつ (that guy - near listener)
- あいつ (that guy - distant from both)
- どいつ (which guy - interrogative)

KANJI:
Can be written {彼奴|あいつ} but usually in hiragana.

NUANCE:
- Casual/rough among friends: affectionate
- About strangers/enemies: contemptuous
- Neutral gender but often used for males

POLITE ALTERNATIVES:
- あの{人|ひと} (that person - polite)
- あの{方|かた} (that person - formal)
- {彼|かれ}/{彼女|かのじょ} (he/she - neutral)

RELATED:
- こいつ (this guy)
- そいつ (that guy)
- どいつ (which guy)
- あの{人|ひと} (that person - polite)
